title: Paper Trading Desk
status: dormant (legacy system; not in the M1/M7 database yet: docs/proposals/legacy_offices.md)
brief: Legacy system: the MSS + IFVG paper trader (private repo thedonnasystem/mss-ifvg-paper). PAPER ONLY, hard-locked: no real-money order is ever placed. It earns no revenue by design; its job is to prove or disprove an edge before the owner decides anything.

agents.title: Risk reviewer
agents.purpose: Reads paper results and risk halts
agents.prompt: Report paper results: trades, win rate, average R, max drawdown, halts. Say plainly when the sample is too small to mean anything. Never suggest real-money trading; that is the owner's decision after a long, honest paper record.

legacy.stack: Python 3.12 (fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, pyyaml), SQLite, Alpaca paper, Yahoo data, Railway

dry_run.note: The 6000-bar replay on the internal simulator: no broker, no key.

changes.change: Keep it paper and let it build a sample: no verdict on edge before about 100 closed paper trades.
Add Alpaca PAPER keys so stocks and crypto use Alpaca paper fills instead of the internal simulator.
Compile the Pine script in TradingView once and compare signals with the Python detector on the same chart (parity is unverified).
